thread:
elaine: Heads-up — drafting the v1->v2 deprecation notice for SDKs + model swap. Need a concise migration checklist and tiny code snippets for Python + TS showing the request-shape change (models -> model, responses API), streaming framing, and a function-calling example. Also need a sweep for old /v1/models links. Who can sanity-check?
marco: I can handle the SDK snippets. Quick Q: do we want to show a compatibility shim in examples or only pure v2 usage?
elaine: Prefer pure v2 examples in the main docs, but include a short "compat shim" note in a migration FAQ for teams that can't upgrade immediately. Also call out the model-fallback behavior — v1 allowed implicit fallbacks, v2 requires explicit model_variant routing.
priya: :thumbsup: Legal wants a 60-day notice window. We'll need the deprecation copy + migration steps ready by EOD so we can schedule. ETA for the PRs?
sam: I'll run a grep across the site and sample apps for /api/v1/ or v1-sdk usage. Will post a list here in a few hours.
deploy-bot: deploybot: docs site deploy scheduled for 2145679950 (no-prod changes allowed between now and deploy).
marco: Draft snippets: 
TS (v2):
```ts
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood-1.0',
  input: 'Summarize the Q2 roadmap.'
})
console.log(res.output[0].content)
```
Python (v2):
```py
resp = client.responses.create(model='redwood-1.0', input='Summarize the Q2 roadmap')
print(resp.output[0].content)
```
Streaming note: use `client.responses.stream` (callback) instead of old `completions.stream`.
marco: Also, short function-calling example (TS):
```ts
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood-1.0',
  input: 'Make a calendar invite if meeting confirmed',
  tools: [{ name: 'calendar', description: 'create events' }]
})
// handle tool calls via tool handlers
```
elaine: Nice. Add a tiny remark about renamed usage fields (old `token_count` -> new `usage.tokens`) and the embedding endpoint rename so teams don't misinterpret billing metrics.
priya: I'll draft the deprecation blurb: 60-day sunset, link to migration checklist, contact support for assisted migration. Will post copy for review before EOD.
sam: Quick scan results: 12 doc pages reference /api/v1/models directly, 3 sample apps still pinning v1 SDKs, 1 tutorial uses `completions.create`. I'll open PRs (#432, #433, #434) to update links and snippets and tag marco for snippet swaps.
marco: I'll push a PR with updated snippets + a small compat helper function for teams who need a transition shim. Target: tomorrow morning.
elaine: Can someone craft a one-line model-swap example showing explicit variant routing? e.g., `client.responses.create(..., model_variant: 'redwood-1x-quant')` — we should show fallback policy in the checklist (explicit fallback > automatic).
priya: Will add an FAQ entry: "What happens to existing API keys and tokens?" with rollback steps and recommended verification tests.
sam: PR list posted: #432 docs-link-fixes, #433 sample-apps-migration, #434 snippet-updates. I'm tagging @marco and @elaine for reviews.
marco: :+1: I'll review #432 tonight and try to get snippet PR up by 09:00 PT.
elaine: Great — once PRs are merged we'll schedule the deprecation announcement to go out after the next docs deploy. Thanks everyone for the quick turn.
